_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Mwari kudya Golf (Kadhi Gemi) - Muzinda {player_id}.
Mukwati: Uye nepakati pfupi zvikuru muRound imwe chete. Iyi zvikamu zvinoshandisa zvinhu zvakazvinja, zvinopimwa sa0.
Mazhini eKadhi: A=1, 2-10=mwaka wakazvipira, J/Q=10, K=0

Mabiko (tsaira brackets zvakajeka):
- '[draw]' - Tora kubva muDeck
- '[take]' - Bata kubva paTsamba yekubvisa
- '[swap X Y]' - Ita kadhi yakatora nenhamba X (mwaka) Y (kolomna)
- '[discard]' - Bvisa kadhi yakatora

board.drew:
Wakazodzwa: {card}
Tsitsi wandakuziva [swap X Y] kana [discard]
board.took:
Mwakabata: {card} kubva pa tsamba yekubvisa
Mwakazopota [swap X Y] nayo (haina kukwata)

options.final_turns: Mapinda ekugura! Makonzo anouya: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Unofanira: [swap X Y] (haugoni kurasa makadhi kubva murwi wokurasa)

message.deck_empty: Dhekisi harina chinhu! Mutambo unoguma pakarepo.
message.knocked: Mutambi {pid} akarova! Mumwe nomumwe mutambi anowana mumwezve mukana.
message.final_round: Muzinda {pid} {reason}! Vanhu vose vaviri vanopinda gare gare

invalid.wrong_action: Tsaira chinhu chimwe chakabatwa: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], kana [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Haugoni kurasa kadhi rinobviswa mumurwi wokurasikirwa. Unofanira kurichinjanisa.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Une kadhi rakadhirowewa. Unofanira [swap X Y] kana kuti [discard] naro.
invalid.knock_with_card: Haugoni kugogodza nekadhi rakadhirowewa. Pedzisa kutendeuka kwako kutanga.
